reason: These data areas are intentionally postponed so ATTHA’S V1 work can continue on the remaining implementation priorities. Existing truth gates and safety restrictions must remain active for any affected claims.

productionPolicy.pricing: Use only facts that already pass the existing branch/channel/freshness truth gate. Otherwise omit price or block the price-dependent creative.
productionPolicy.ingredients: Do not state or visually require unverified ingredients as factual product attributes.
productionPolicy.allergens: Do not make allergen claims until authoritative data is supplied.
productionPolicy.offers: Do not publish deferred offers without a fresh verified state.
productionPolicy.availability: Do not claim branch-level product availability unless already verified for the requested scope.
productionPolicy.productPhotos: Without an approved real product reference, generated food imagery remains concept/reference imagery and cannot be represented as a verified real ATTHA’S product photograph.

resumeWhen: Owner elects to provide/reconcile these operational datasets later.
